description: This file defines a React hook 'useFocusTrap' that traps keyboard focus within a specified container element, managing focus behavior for accessibility purposes. It includes logic for focus management, DOM observation, and focus restoration.

methods.name: useFocusTrap
methods.description: A React hook that traps keyboard focus within a container element, managing focus cycling and optional focus restoration.

methods.name: getFocusableElements
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve all focusable elements within a container, filtering out hidden elements.

methods.name: isElementVisible
methods.description: Checks if an element is visible in the DOM based on size and computed styles.
